mechanism_card.hypothesis: Shifting 10% of R0's dots from the bottom-half 5 km blocks (by mean parent field q) into the top half at fixed count gains DTI because Basin-and-Range faulting is clustered at km scale (systems, relays, step-overs): blocks where independent physics already agree host denser unmapped structure per ridge pixel.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Per-dot ranking saturates locally (maximal 2.8 px packing); the remaining allocation question is geographic. Donor dots are the lowest exact-gain R0 dots in low-prior blocks; refills are the greedy top-gain canonical-pool dots in high-prior blocks at d_cat>=3 px, so only block membership changes.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Block q tracks data, not faults: GeoDAWN Area 1 vs Area 2 line spacing, lidar/radiometric coverage edges, and lineament-rich volcanic/caldera terrains raise mean q without raising throughgoing-fault density.
mechanism_card.predicted_sign_and_size: Bracketing, positive center: -0.004 to +0.013 DTI (MODEL credit scenario).
mechanism_card.falsifier: Live <= R0 CLAIM - 0.002 while spread-m2400 >= R0 falsifies the clustering prior at 5 km: high-q blocks are then catalogue-complete (already mapped), and residual truth sits in quiet blocks.
